view-01.png.evidence: Wing markings remain distinct in isolated positions.
view-01.png.regressions: Soft central silhouettes, disk effects and inline labels muddy the fight.

view-02.png.evidence: Beach boundary and runway are immediately recognizable.
view-02.png.regressions: Field grid and mottling compete with the tiny player plane; little shoreline effect.

view-03.png.evidence: Runway markings, rocks and shoreline form clear landmarks.
view-03.png.regressions: Low contrast around the blue plane, repeated tree blobs and a nearly bare waterline.

view-04.png.evidence: Ring picks out the plane and the runway, aprons and buildings form a readable compound.
view-04.png.regressions: Soft small shapes and an understated, separated line of shore foam.

view-05.png.evidence: Bright silhouettes frame the darker carrier and small impacts pick out the deck.
view-05.png.regressions: Bow overlap makes the selected airframe less legible; wake reads as a soft plume.

view-06.png.evidence: Crisp ring, grounded foliage and visible shallows define an easy-to-read coastline.
view-06.png.regressions: Foam strokes are thin and disconnected; terrain plots are understated.

view-07.png.evidence: Clean carrier silhouette, shadowed tower and selected-plane ring make a clear focal grouping.
view-07.png.regressions: Uniform dark water texture and single smooth wake limit variation.

view-08.png.evidence: Warm wing paint, individual silhouettes and concentrated deck sparks sort the formation. Aircraft materials read more consistently as a group.
view-08.png.regressions: Upper HUD crops aircraft, and the bow ring overlaps packed silhouettes.

view-09.png.evidence: Runway and sand strip define the coast; aircraft contour is fairly clear.
view-09.png.regressions: Broad grass mottling and scattered offshore flecks undercut material scale.

view-10.png.evidence: Ring, detailed runway and distinct building volumes define the airfield at a glance.
view-10.png.regressions: Diffuse yard/grass boundaries and thin offshore streaks look underdeveloped.

view-11.png.evidence: Warm impact colors and cool sea distinguish the combat cluster.
view-11.png.regressions: Soft silhouettes bunch near the ship and upper HUD covers aircraft.

view-12.png.evidence: Warm wing accents and thin smoke pick out combat aircraft against the cool water. The clustered palette is consistent.
view-12.png.regressions: Soft silhouettes still crowd the deck, especially under the upper HUD and around the bow ring.

view-13.png.evidence: Red wing marks and warm hits remain legible on the tan deck. Lone wing shapes read cleanly against the cool sea.
view-13.png.regressions: The ring and layered aircraft still make selection near the bow ambiguous. The stern wake is diffuse.

view-14.png.evidence: Crisp walls, material changes and tactical paths give rooms a clear structure.
view-14.png.regressions: Unit markers and routes can crowd the narrow hallway; effects are subdued.

view-15.png.evidence: Crisp ring, grounded foliage and visible shallows define an easy-to-read coastline.
view-15.png.regressions: Foam strokes are thin and disconnected; terrain plots are understated.

view-16.png.evidence: Uncluttered carrier silhouette, ring and light-dark tower contrast give a clear focus.
view-16.png.regressions: Soft deck/aircraft boundaries and a single broad plume limit detail.

view-17.png.evidence: Ship placement and runway markings are straightforward.
view-17.png.regressions: Blurred bare deck, hard wake rectangle and text over the ship flatten the scene.

view-18.png.evidence: The wing markings and consistent light airframes separate from dark water and make a readable perimeter around the carrier.
view-18.png.regressions: Orange hits are small and the bow overlap still obscures the highlighted airframe.

view-19.png.evidence: Airframes and fire remain distinct in most of the crowded formation; tower casts a useful dark shape.
view-19.png.regressions: HUD hides the uppermost planes and center ring intersects several silhouettes.

view-20.png.evidence: Clean carrier silhouette, shadowed tower and selected-plane ring make a clear focal grouping.
view-20.png.regressions: Uniform dark water texture and single smooth wake limit variation.

view-21.png.evidence: Hard coastline and runway edge organize the frame.
view-21.png.regressions: Tiny overlaid labels and plane compete with the field grid; isolated white flecks distract at sea.

view-22.png.evidence: Strong directional light and props give the market density and depth; colored routes identify activity.
view-22.png.regressions: Warm shadows hide figures among crowded stalls, and route lines cross nearby props.

view-23.png.evidence: Fog separates depth layers and vehicle flashes read against detailed autumn terrain.
view-23.png.regressions: Distant silhouettes recede into fog; unit status is not visible.

view-24.png.evidence: Wet ground, raking light and shadows create strong volume; rain, smoke and tracer share the scene lighting.
view-24.png.regressions: Dark distant units and shaded infantry are difficult to identify quickly.

view-25.png.evidence: Ring, detailed runway and distinct building volumes define the airfield at a glance.
view-25.png.regressions: Diffuse yard/grass boundaries and thin offshore streaks look underdeveloped.

view-26.png.evidence: A few clear aircraft silhouettes survive the central cluster.
view-26.png.regressions: Overlapping labels and disk-shaped hits cover the deck; wake is abrupt.

view-27.png.evidence: Aircraft silhouettes remain distinct away from the deck.
view-27.png.regressions: Center overlay, rounded smoke disks and hard-edged wake flatten the encounter.

view-28.png.evidence: Aircraft markings and sea contrast separate units at the perimeter.
view-28.png.regressions: Overlapping translucent disks and labels obscure the flat center deck; wake is a rectangular strip.

view-29.png.evidence: Runway arrow and field boundaries organize the airfield.
view-29.png.regressions: Overlaid objective crosses the player, geometric trees and soft mottling dominate, no integrated shoreline effect.

view-30.png.evidence: Marked planes stand out on the teal sea and deck markings survive the crowd.
view-30.png.regressions: Effects read as scattered flecks, and selected plane is harder to find in the cluster.

view-31.png.evidence: Ring and layered beach-to-blue transition anchor the player and the edge of land.
view-31.png.regressions: Soft vegetation and detached, repeating foam strokes limit material realism.

view-32.png.evidence: Ring picks out the plane and the runway, aprons and buildings form a readable compound.
view-32.png.regressions: Soft small shapes and an understated, separated line of shore foam.

view-33.png.evidence: Sharp wings, ship shadow and deck lines give a legible air-and-sea composition.
view-33.png.regressions: Closest aircraft overlaps the bow and pale flecks add competing accents.

view-34.png.evidence: Runway stripes and geometric fields make navigation cues visible.
view-34.png.regressions: Plane is buried in overlaid text, hills and trees are faceted, and offshore flecks lack a shore interaction.

view-35.png.evidence: Ring and layered beach-to-blue transition anchor the player and the edge of land.
view-35.png.regressions: Soft vegetation and detached, repeating foam strokes limit material realism.

view-36.png.evidence: Uncluttered carrier silhouette, ring and light-dark tower contrast give a clear focus.
view-36.png.regressions: Soft deck/aircraft boundaries and a single broad plume limit detail.

view-37.png.evidence: Distinct aircraft markings, hull and quiet smoke preserve much of the formation.
view-37.png.regressions: Center remains crowded; pale wave pattern and soft small details limit definition.

view-38.png.evidence: Deck geometry, tower and trail establish ship direction.
view-38.png.regressions: Blue plane merges into the narrow bow; broad teal swirls repeat.

view-39.png.evidence: Hangars and runway form a clear airfield; tree shadows add anchoring.
view-39.png.regressions: Plane overlaps a roof, soft foliage edges and faceted hill clash with broad ground mottling.

view-40.png.evidence: Sharp runway and roof lines organize the field.
view-40.png.regressions: Player blends against a blue roof, left hill looks faceted, and offshore flecks seem unrelated.

view-41.png.evidence: Carrier tower and plane insignia establish targets clearly away from the bow.
view-41.png.regressions: Soft outlines and wake have little structure; bow overlap compromises player identification.

view-42.png.evidence: Dark aircraft silhouettes and layered rocky terrain converge on a high-energy tracer and fire burst.
view-42.png.regressions: The bright burst occludes several nearby units; overlapping dark forms are harder to parse.

view-43.png.evidence: Clear deck markings and tower define direction and ship volume.
view-43.png.regressions: Aircraft is low contrast at the bow; offshore flecks resemble stray particles.

view-44.png.evidence: Bow ring and wing insignia help sorting; hull has a dimensional edge and orange hits remain visible.
view-44.png.regressions: Aircraft overlap on the bow, softened edges reduce separation, and the wake is mostly diffuse.

view-45.png.evidence: Isolated deck silhouette and markings are easy to locate.
view-45.png.regressions: Uniform deck has little volume; wake is a hard rectangle and labels sit across play space.
